targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_ins WHERE status = 'submitted' AND team_id IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
SELECT event_name, COUNT(*) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name IN ('proof_approved', 'proof_rejected') AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY event_name
SELECT approver_role, COUNT(*) FROM check_ins WHERE status IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND team_id IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY approver_role
SELECT team_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', ts) as week, COUNT(*) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'proof_submitted' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY team_id, week ORDER BY week
